key_interactions.effect: Rosuvastatin exposure up 7-fold; myopathy and rhabdomyolysis risk (label).
key_interactions.action: Do not exceed rosuvastatin 5 mg once daily.

key_interactions.effect: Higher rosuvastatin exposure; myopathy and rhabdomyolysis (label).
key_interactions.action: Avoid; if unavoidable, start 5 mg once daily and do not exceed 10 mg once daily.

key_interactions.effect: Much higher rosuvastatin levels; myopathy risk (label).

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Other hepatitis C antivirals and boosted protease inhibitors (sofosbuvir/velpatasvir, glecaprevir/pibrentasvir, elbasvir/grazoprevir, atazanavir/ritonavir, lopinavir/ritonavir)
key_interactions.action: Start 5 mg once daily; do not exceed 10 mg once daily.
Do not exceed rosuvastatin 5 mg once daily.
Give rosuvastatin at least 2 hours before the antacid.
Check INR before starting; monitor frequently until stable.
